subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should OpenClaw surface the existing admin-scoped config path in the Overview snapshot card, move it to a Settings/config information area, or keep this information on existing CLI/gateway metadata surfaces only?
rationale: The code path is small, but the request changes prominent Control UI diagnostics and displays an absolute local path, so product and UX placement intent should be explicit before merge.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Approve the Overview snapshot placement and merge after real behavior proof confirms the row appears only when the gateway provides the admin-scoped field.

options.title: Move To Settings
options.body: Ask the contributor to display the same existing field in a Settings or config information surface instead of the Overview card.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Close or narrow the PR if maintainers do not want another UI surface for local config paths beyond existing CLI and gateway metadata.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Approve the Overview snapshot placement and merge after real behavior proof confirms the row appears only when the gateway provides the admin-scoped field.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent current-main history for the Overview layout points to fuller-stack-dev, making them the best available routing candidate for the UI placement choice.
